title: Journey podcast
description: A journey's podcast: one audio file whose segments are linked to the journey's steps and animation beats (docs/podcast-format.md). It sits next to its journey as <slug>.podcast.json.
$comment: From src/core/format/podcast/model.ts parsePodcast and src/core/format/podcast/validate.ts validatePodcast (journey.py podcast_problems has the same rules). The errors (the podcast can't be played) are all here: version, audio (present, a relative path that stays in the journeys folder), segments (a non-empty list). The field types the validator warns about are here too, since they define a well-formed file: at (null or {step, beat}), beat a whole number >= 1, cue, start/end as seconds, duration a number, sentences as a non-empty list of {start, text}, marks as {phrase, at, lines, ...}. Unknown fields, in the file or a segment, are allowed (generators keep their own data there, e.g. say). Not expressible here: at least one segment with a start; ids unique; segments in time order without overlap; end >= start and within duration; sentence starts in order and inside the segment; mark at within the segment and in time order; a phrase found in text; a file on marks of a segment whose at is null; steps and beats the journey has; the audio file existing and not empty. audio: the pattern refuses a URL, an absolute path and a path starting with ..; a path that leaves the folder later (a/../../x) is refused by the validator but not by this pattern. duration must be above 0 (written as minimum 0: exclusiveMinimum is not in the keyword subset). A mark's at may be up to 0.05 s before the segment (rounding); this schema says minimum 0.

journey.description: The journey it was written for.

file.description: The journey file, relative to the repository.

commit.description: The commit the podcast was recorded for.

audio.description: The audio file, relative to this file, inside the journeys folder (not a URL, not absolute).

duration.description: The episode's length in seconds (the audio's own length wins).

segment.description: A part of the episode: who says what, when, and where in the journey it belongs.

id.description: Stable when segments are edited or removed.

at.description: Where it belongs: null (the whole journey: the map), {step} (the step), or {step, beat} (the step's animation at that beat).

anyOf.description: The whole journey (the map, no step open).

cue.description: How the change of place is shown.

say.description: The spoken form sent to text-to-speech (ignored by the player).

start.description: When it starts, in seconds of the audio.

end.description: When it ends, in seconds of the audio.

sentences.description: When each sentence of text starts.

marks.description: Parts of the code lit while the voice says a phrase.

at.description: A step of the journey, optionally at a beat of its animation.

beat.description: The beat, 1-based, counted in the step's scene.beats.

sentence.description: A sentence of the segment's text and when it starts.

start.description: When the sentence starts, in seconds of the audio.

mark.description: A mark lit while the voice says a phrase: a code mark plus the phrase and its time.

phrase.description: The words in text the mark goes with.

at.description: Seconds from the segment's start when the phrase is said.
